## Changelog

- Simplify the README with a real app screenshot, standard sections and GitHub notes for important information.
- Move detailed user and build documentation into separate guides, with instructions focused on the current version.

## Instructions

- For installation, download the DMG or ZIP matching your account region: Global or CN.
- To update an installed app, choose Settings → Check for Updates → Update and Restart.
